- [**Restaurant Jungfrau-Aletsch**\\
\\
RestaurantNaters\\
\\
The host and top chef Remo Jossen likes to work with regional products.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/food-wine/restaurant/restaurant-jungfrau-aletsch/)
- [**Swiss Alps Jungfrau-Aletsch**\\
\\
Place\\
\\
The Jungfrau-Aletsch Region was chosen as the first Alpine UNESCO World Natural Heritage Site in 2001. At its heart lies the mighty rock massif of the Eiger, Mönch and Jungfrau and the glacial landscape around the Great Aletsch Glacier.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/destinations/unesco-world-heritage-swiss-alps-jungfrau-aletsch/)
- [**Entrance to the visitor centre of the UNESCO World Heritage Swiss Alps Jungfrau-Aletsch**\\
\\
OfferNatersNovember 15, 2026\\
\\
World Nature Forum – the most modern and fascinating museum in the Alps. An interactive exhibition for all the senses. Here, you can discover the world heritage site with all its natural beauty, traditions and challenges.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/planning/offers/entrance-to-the-visitor-centre-of-the-unesco-world-heritage-swiss-alps-jungfrau-aletsch/)
- [**Eggishorn viewpoint: look out over the Great Aletsch Glacier**\\
\\
Place\\
\\
The Jungfrau-Aletsch UNESCO World Heritage Site seems close enough to touch, as 20 kilometres of the Aletsch Glacier stretch out right in front of your eyes. This is a viewpoint where you will want to take your time and marvel at the sights before you.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/destinations/eggishorn-viewpoint-look-out-over-the-great-aletsch-glacier/)
- [**Gondola Kandersteg – Lake Oeschinen**\\
\\
ExperienceKandersteg\\
\\
Take the Kandersteg – Oeschinensee gondola to the UNESCO World Heritage Jungfrau-Aletsch. Enjoy hiking trails, toboggan run and mountain lake.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/gondola-to-lake-oeschinen/)
- [**From Lucerne: Day tour Jungfraujoch by bus and cogwheel train**\\
\\
OfferLucerneNovember 15, 2026\\
\\
Leave the city of Lucerne and admire the UNESCO World Natural Heritage Site Jungfrau-Aletsch. Enjoy an adventure tour and marvel at the breathtaking panorama from the Jungfraujoch.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/planning/offers/from-lucerne-day-tour-jungfraujoch-by-bus-and-cogwheel-train/)
- [**Trail Run Bettmeralp**\\
\\
RouteBettmeralp\\
\\
This loop follows a smooth trail alongside the Great Aletsch Glacier. In 2001, the Jungfrau-Aletsch protected area was made a UNESCO World Heritage site, and the trails here couldn’t be better for running.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/trail-run-bettmeralp/)
- [**Rosenlaui Glacier Gorge**\\
\\
ExperienceMeiringen-Hasliberg\\
\\
The Rosenlaui Glacier Gorge: Discover narrow passages, thundering waterfalls and bizarre rock formations in the UNESCO World Heritage Swiss Alps Jungfrau-Aletsch.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/rosenlaui-glacier-gorge/)
- [**Mund**\\
\\
Place\\
\\
The saffron village of Mund is located on a sunny hillside at 1200 m above sea level, on the right side of the Vallée du Rhône, within the Jungfrau-Aletsch UNESCO World Natural Heritage Site.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/destinations/mund/)
- [**Aletschhorn**\\
\\
Place\\
\\
The second-highest peak in the Bernese Alps is also considered to be the coldest across the entire Alpine region. The highly glaciated Aletschhorn towers over the UNESCO-listed Jungfrau-Aletsch area.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/destinations/aletschhorn-4193m-asl/)
- [**Kiental**\\
\\
Place\\
\\
The Kien Valley in the Bernese Oberland, a holiday resort with about 210 inhabitants, is a side valley of the Kandertal. The end of the valley is part of the Jungfrau-Aletsch UNESCO World Heritage Site. The Kien Valley is within the administrative district of Reichenbach.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/destinations/kien-valley/)
- [**Schmadri Hut**\\
\\
AccommodationStechelberg\\
\\
Located at 2,262 meters, high up in the Lauterbrunnen Valley, at the foot of the north-west ridge of the Grosshorn, in the midst of the UNESCO World Heritage Region "Swiss Alps Jungfrau–Aletsch".](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/accommodations/schmadri-hut/)
- [**Photo Spot Great Aletsch Glacier**\\
\\
ExperienceEggishorn viewpoint: look out over the Great Aletsch Glacier\\
\\
Note: The photo spot has been temporarily removed due to construction and is expected to be available again in the summer of 2027.\\
\\
With its length of about 20 km (14 mi), the Great Aletsch Glacier is at the centre of Swiss Alps Jungfrau-Aletsch, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. 10 billions tonnes of ice make the Great Aletsch Glacier the Alps' largest glacier, which is easily accessible thanks to many hiking trails and glacier tour offers. The 360° panoramic view from the Eggishorn is just as impressive: Eiger, Mönch, Jungfrau, Wannenhorn and Finsteraarhorn – and to the west the Weisshorn, the Mischabel with the Dom as well as Matterhorn in all its glory.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/photo-spot-great-aletsch-glacier/)
- [**Alpencamping**\\
\\
AccommodationMeiringen-Hasliberg](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/accommodations/alpencamping/)
- [**Hotel Kirchbühl**\\
\\
AccommodationGrindelwald\\
\\
First-class holidays at the foot of the Eiger North Face: The cosy chalet hotel with Alpine charm is run by the fourth generation of the Brawand family. The quiet rooms all have balconies and beautiful views of the mountains. Both of the hotel’s restaurants put emphasis on high-quality cuisine and regional specialties. An ideal base for bike tours and hikes.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/accommodations/hotel-kirchbuehl/)
- [**Wittene zum Oeschinensee**\\
\\
ExperienceKandersteg\\
\\
Piste facilities in the family ski area at Oeschinensee are easy to operate and provide for leisurely skiing. Here, it’s not about the speed – just take a deep breath and enjoy. This valley descent past the frozen Oeschinensee lake to Kandersteg provides some delightful experiences in nature.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/wittene-zum-oeschinensee/)
- [**Trip to the Jungfraujoch**\\
\\
Place\\
\\
On the Top of Europe: A visit to the Jungfraujoch puts a jewel in the crown of any visit to Switzerland.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/destinations/jungfraujoch/)
- [**Massa Gorge**\\
\\
ExperienceBlatten-Belalp\\
\\
While in the past it was only courageous crystal hunters who braved the Massa Gorge, it is now accessible to the general public thanks to the building of the Gibidem Dam.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/massa-gorge/)
- [**Glacier Canyon Grindelwald**\\
\\
ExperienceGrindelwald\\
\\
The Grindelwald Glacier Gorge: Hike through the deep gorge and experience thrills on the Spiderweb, a net high above the glacial stream.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/grindelwald-glacial-gorge/)
- [**Konkordia SAC**\\
\\
AccommodationFiesch](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/accommodations/konkordia-sac/)
